name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
description: Statutory demand-driven wage employment scheme guaranteeing at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
target_beneficiaries: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work
benefits: Guaranteed minimum 100 days of wage employment per financial year at statutory state wage rates, with unemployment allowance payable if employment is not provided within 15 days of demand.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India under statutory authority of the MGNREG Act, 2005.
Statutory demand-driven national rural employment guarantee applicable to all rural districts nationwide.
Any adult resident of a rural area who registers and applies for unskilled manual work.
Guaranteed 100 days of manual wage employment per household, with wages disbursed directly into bank/post office accounts via ABPS (Aadhaar-Based Payment System).
Official NREGASoft management information system hosted at nrega.nic.in.
Active nationwide operations disbursing daily wages across over 2.5 lakh Gram Panchayats with mandatory NMMS mobile app attendance.

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Employment is guaranteed for unskilled manual work only; urban residents are excluded.

required_documents.title: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: UIDAI Aadhaar card for ABPS wage credit.

required_documents.title: MGNREGA Job Card
required_documents.description: Household Job Card issued by local Gram Panchayat.
required_documents.guidance: If not yet issued, apply at local Gram Panchayat with family details and photo.

required_documents.title: Bank / Post Office Passbook
required_documents.description: Savings account linked with Aadhaar NPCI mapper.
